purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral/parcel map services for Najran, Saudi Arabia; geometry and coverage claims are limited to observed evidence.
name: Najran

queries.query: Najran Saudi Arabia official cadastral parcel GIS map land parcels
queries.result: Found the official Saudi government Urban Maps service for Najran Municipality, describing a Balady digital map with land-plot layers, and the official Ministry service page linking to Balady. The live viewer was reachable anonymously, but no bounded parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: نجران خريطة عقارات كادستر GIS قطع الأراضي هيئة المساحة الجيومكانية السعودية
queries.result: Found official Arabic REGA and GEOSA descriptions of geospatial real-estate and national geospatial services, plus the Arabic Urban Maps service route. These establish service scope/procedure, not a Najran parcel geometry response.

officialSources.observation: Saudi National Portal identifies Urban Maps as a Najran Municipality service and describes a digital map covering city geospatial data, including land uses and related map data; the page says the service is delivered through Balady.

Ministry of Municipalities and Housing describes Urban Maps as a government map across Saudi cities with land plots, land-use classifications, plot sizes and building regulations, and links to the Balady service.

The official Real Estate General Authority describes a geospatial real-estate portal with interactive maps including cities, neighborhoods and land parcels. This is national agency/service documentation, not a Najran-bounded parcel response.

The current public Urban Maps viewer loaded anonymously. Its current JavaScript exposed Config.Api, Identity.Api, App.Api and App2.Api base paths and ArcGIS client support; no public parcel service URL or query response was identified from the loaded configuration.

requests.outcome: Current English service page loaded. It documents the Urban Maps procedure and land-plot layer, but is not itself a parcel geometry API.
Anonymous viewer shell loaded. The current JavaScript/configuration was inspected; no login or credential was used.

registryBasis: A first-party Saudi government service is explicitly identified as Najran Municipality Urban Maps and its published procedure includes land-plot data. This establishes a local municipal map/procedure, but not anonymous parcel geometry, a cadastral legal custodian, or runtime API admission.
